title: Your rollout plan
label: An eight-week customer rollout on a time axis with two tracks: Your team and Our team. A Today marker walks the weeks; finished steps fill in, multi-day work fills as it passes, later steps stay outlined. When it reaches the first live workflow in week 5 its flag opens into a card.
heading:
Live in eight weeks,
with a plan you can see.
sub: Every rollout follows the same plan: who does what, and when, from kickoff to sign-off.

milestones.title: First workflow live
milestones.note: Your first automated workflow runs on real data, and we watch every run for a week.
